name: ExPipedrive CI failure triage
description: When Elixir CI fails on a PR, read the failing check and open a fix or comment with root cause.

prompts.text:
Elixir CI failed on blksheep80/ex_pipedrive.

1. Read the failing GitHub Actions check log (format, credo, dialyzer, test, or coveralls).
2. Identify the root cause — do not guess without reading the log.
3. If the fix is clearly within PR scope and small, implement it on a branch and open a draft PR (or push to the existing PR branch if appropriate).
4. If the failure is unrelated to the PR or needs human judgment, post a PR comment explaining why.

Never weaken CI configs, skip dialyzer, or lower the 75% Coveralls floor to make checks pass.

Local verification before pushing:
- Run the narrowest failing command first (e.g. mix test path/to_test.exs)
- Then mix format --check-formatted and mix credo --strict if those failed

See AGENTS.md for the full quality gate.
